outputs: Generated symptom inquiries and disease diagnoses
Generated symptom inquiry sequences and disease labels for automatic diagnosis.

changes_made.explanation: Added 'Text Generation' as a more general task category since the paper focuses on generating symptom sequences. Added 'Chinese' as a language since datasets are in Chinese. Removed 'BERT_full' as it's not a distinct model but rather BERT applied to full symptom sets. Normalized HDQN to H-DQN for consistency.
Normalized all metrics to consistent title case. Combined 'symptom recall' and 'implicit symptom recall' into 'Implicit Symptom Recall' as they refer to the same metric.
Cleared all fields as the paper does not use LLMs as judges. Removed placeholder 'None' values.
Cleared all fields as the paper does not conduct human evaluations. Removed placeholder 'None' values.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on automatic diagnosis through symptom generation using Transformer-based models. It uses Chinese medical dialogue datasets and evaluates primarily with automatic metrics. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are employed. The extraction was generally accurate but required normalization of metric names and clarification of task categories.
